tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get designer profile
tools.description: Get the portfolio owner's public profile: positioning, focus areas, social links, site pages, and the tool stack used day to day.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the portfolio's design projects and case studies with their role, year, industry, tags and live URLs. Optionally filter by a free-text query.

query.description: Optional text filter matched against name, tagline, industry and tags.

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get project case study
tools.description: Get the full public case-study summary for one portfolio project by its id (use list_projects to discover ids).

tools.name: list_experiments
tools.title: List playground experiments
tools.description: List the interactive playground experiments (title, description, status, stack and highlights) featured on the portfolio.
